leftEvidence.title: God finishes, rests, blesses, and makes the seventh day holy

points.label: Work
points.left: The work of creation is finished.
points.right: Human work is bounded by six days.

points.label: Rest
points.left: God rests on the seventh day.
points.right: The seventh day becomes Sabbath rest.

points.label: Blessing
points.left: God blesses and sanctifies the seventh day.
points.right: The command cites Yahweh blessing the Sabbath day and making it holy.

payload.posture: Hold the first seventh day beside the later command that explicitly remembers it.

rightEvidence.title: Israel’s Sabbath is grounded in creation

payload.tension: Genesis describes God finishing and resting; Exodus turns that completed pattern into a command governing Israel’s recurring work and rest.
payload.title: Rest / remembered rest
